name: Extract Document to Markdown
description: Read a document as Markdown: PDF, HTML, image (OCR) or audio (returns the speech transcription). Use this instead of file_read for anything that is not plain text — file_read returns garbage on binary files. Extracted images are saved as files and linked inline.

path.description: Path to the document (.pdf, .html, an image, or an audio file)

language.description: Audio only: ISO code (e.g. 'it') to skip auto-detection.

image_dir.description: Where to write extracted images. Default: a per-file folder under /tmp.

max_pages.description: PDF only: maximum pages to process.

ocr.description: Run OCR on image files. Ignored for PDF/HTML.
